Private Function Reads(ch As Object, ByVal points As Boolean) As String
    Dim s As String, v As String, n As Long, i As Long, k As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "n=" & ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    For k = 1 To ch.SeriesCollection.Count
        v = "-": v = ch.SeriesCollection(k).Formula
        s = s & " |" & v
        n = -1: n = ch.SeriesCollection(k).Points.Count
        s = s & " pts=" & n
        v = "-": v = ch.SeriesCollection(k).HasErrorBars
        s = s & " eb=" & v
        If Not points Then n = 0
        For i = 1 To n
            v = "-"
            If k = 1 Then v = ch.SeriesCollection(k).Points(i).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB _
                Else v = ch.SeriesCollection(k).Points(i).HasDataLabel
            s = s & " " & v
        Next
    Next
    Err.Clear
    Reads = s
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal way As String, ByVal path As String, ByVal folder As String, ByVal edit As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, d As Worksheet, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If way = "loaded" Then
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Else
        Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
        Build
    End If
    Set d = wb.Worksheets("Data")
    d.Activate
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    Select Case edit

        Case ""
        Case "d.Columns(""D:E"").Delete"
            d.Columns("D:E").Delete
        Case "d.Columns(1).Delete"
            d.Columns(1).Delete
        Case "d.Columns(2).Delete"
            d.Columns(2).Delete
        Case "d.Columns(3).Delete"
            d.Columns(3).Delete
        Case "d.Columns(4).Delete"
            d.Columns(4).Delete
        Case "d.Columns(4).Insert"
            d.Columns(4).Insert
        Case "d.Range(""A3:E3"").Delete xlShiftUp"
            d.Range("A3:E3").Delete xlShiftUp
        Case "d.Range(""A3:E3"").Insert xlShiftDown"
            d.Range("A3:E3").Insert xlShiftDown
        Case "d.Range(""B2:B5"").Delete xlShiftToLeft"
            d.Range("B2:B5").Delete xlShiftToLeft
        Case "d.Range(""B3"").Delete xlShiftUp"
            d.Range("B3").Delete xlShiftUp
        Case "d.Range(""B3"").Insert xlShiftDown"
            d.Range("B3").Insert xlShiftDown
        Case "d.Range(""B3:C3"").Delete xlShiftUp"
            d.Range("B3:C3").Delete xlShiftUp
        Case "d.Range(""D2:D5"").Delete xlShiftUp"
            d.Range("D2:D5").Delete xlShiftUp
        Case "d.Range(""D3"").Delete xlShiftUp"
            d.Range("D3").Delete xlShiftUp
        Case "d.Range(""D3"").Insert xlShiftDown"
            d.Range("D3").Insert xlShiftDown
        Case "d.Rows(""2:5"").Delete"
            d.Rows("2:5").Delete
        Case "d.Rows(""3:4"").Delete"
            d.Rows("3:4").Delete
        Case "d.Rows(1).Delete"
            d.Rows(1).Delete
        Case "d.Rows(2).Delete"
            d.Rows(2).Delete
        Case "d.Rows(3).Delete"
            d.Rows(3).Delete
        Case "d.Rows(3).Insert"
            d.Rows(3).Insert
        Case "d.Rows(6).Insert"
            d.Rows(6).Insert
    End Select
    s = "err=" & Err.Number & " " & Reads(d.ChartObjects(1).Chart, way = "session")
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\saved.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
End Function
